summary: Completed frontend testing of UI improvements: Mobile responsiveness, Guests page pagination & columns, Calendar cancelled bookings styling, and Check-in modal booking amount display. All features verified working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Used existing test data (Test CheckIn Guest booking, cancelled bookings visible in calendar)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All UI improvements implemented and tested. Guests page has correct columns (no Completed Stays), Last Stay text is white, pagination works (20 per page). Calendar shows separate booked/cancelled counts, red styling for cancelled. Check-in modal shows Booking Amount section. Restaurant and Settings pages are mobile responsive.

guests_page_columns.details: Columns are: Guest Name, Email, Phone, Total Bookings, Upcoming Bookings, Last Stay, Actions. 'Completed Stays' column successfully removed.

guests_page_last_stay_color.details: Last Stay column uses 'text-sm text-white' class - white text as required

guests_page_pagination.details: Pagination set to 20 guests per page. Only 4 guests exist so pagination controls don't show (correct behavior when total < page size)

calendar_legend.details: Legend shows: Booked (blue), Cancelled (red), Sold Out (amber), Available (gray)

calendar_separate_counts.details: Each date shows separate counts: 'X booked' (blue badge) and 'X cancelled' (red badge). Day 23 shows '2 booked' and '3 cancelled'

calendar_room_badge.details: Calendar popup shows room number badge next to guest name (e.g., 'Room 101')

calendar_cancelled_styling.details: Cancelled bookings show with red styling (bg-red-900/30), red text (text-red-300), and 'CANCELLED' badge

checkin_modal_booking_amount.details: Check-in modal shows 'Booking Amount' section with blue background (bg-blue-50), displays 'Rate per Night' and 'Total Room Charges'

restaurant_modal_mobile.details: Restaurant New Order modal uses 'flex flex-col md:flex-row' for mobile-first responsive layout. Table/Room Service buttons, menu items, and Order Summary all display properly on mobile

settings_page_mobile.details: Settings page tabs display properly on mobile viewport (390x844)
